verdict.rationale: Notte's own docs include a guide for integrating OpenAI's Computer Use Agent (CUA) with Notte's browser infrastructure, so a first-party, screenshot-driven computer-use path exists. However, it relies on an external OpenAI model rather than a native vision mode you can switch on in Notte's own agent, and the evidence otherwise describes Notte's agent as DOM/observe-based. Missing for 10: a native vision or computer-use action mode toggle in Notte's agent or SDK, documentation that it handles canvases and non-DOM UIs, details of the CUA integration beyond a one-line summary, and any hands-on corroboration.
